kuusalo_naatanen.title: Geometric uniformization in genus 2
kuusalo_naatanen.journal: Annales Academiae Scientiarum Fennicae, Series A I Mathematica
locators: Case D: paper pp.405-406 / PDF P4, equation w^2=z^5-z, W={0,infinity,+/-1,+/-i}, reduced rotation z->i z
paper pp.408-409 / PDF P7-P8: canonical homology basis B=(a1,a2,b1,b2) and theta(f1) for rotation by pi/4
source_supported_facts: Case D is Bolza surface with equation w^2=z^5-z and branch values {0,infinity,+/-1,+/-i}.
The reduced cyclic generator acts by z->i z and fixes branch labels 0 and infinity.
B=(a1,a2,b1,b2) is a canonical symplectic homology basis.
For f1, rotation around 0 by pi/4, the integral homology matrix theta(f1) is explicitly given.

cecotti.title: Symplectic Singularities, Color Confinement, and the Quantum Dirac Sheaf
source_supported_facts: The retained G12 presentation uses S=b4 and T=-b3.
The same ppav is the Jacobian of y^2=x^5-x.
B.9 gives an order-8 automorphism (x,y)->(i x, exp(i*pi/4)y).
The source does not explicitly identify B.9 with a literal word in S,T on the retained marked lattice.

source_side_exact_reconstruction.deduction: delta_0inf=[P0-Pinfinity] is nonzero and fixed because the branch labels 0 and infinity are fixed; the f1 mod-2 fixed subspace has exactly one nonzero vector.
source_side_exact_reconstruction.lift_sign_firewall: The two curve lifts above z->i z differ by the hyperelliptic involution. On J[2] that involution is -1=+1, so the mod-2 fixed-vector conclusion is lift-sign independent.

finite_literal_intertwiner_test.definition: Q maps Kuusalo source coordinates to retained coordinates and must satisfy Q^T E_target Q=J_source and A_target Q=Q M_source over F2.

residual_ambiguity.what_new_source_kills: The source-side ambiguity of where delta_0inf sits in one branch-labelled canonical J[2] basis.
residual_ambiguity.what_remains: Which retained inner conjugate/lattice marking realizes the branch-labelled Kuusalo basis and its order-8 automorphism.
residual_ambiguity.why_97_not_promoted: Fixing literal A=S*T^-1 gives L2 for every compatible intertwiner, but the current sources still do not prove that the geometric order-8 automorphism is represented by that literal retained word rather than an admissible inner conjugate.
